_comment: Synthetic per-GPU throttling example for configs/cluster/moe_pd_tp2_pp2_instance.json (Qwen3-30B-A3B, RTX PRO 6000, TP=2 PP=2). Cluster total_npu=12: instance 0 (prefill) owns physical NPUs 0-3 plus shadow receiver range 4-7 (transfer fiction, NOT a GPU -- never list here); instance 1 (decode) owns NPUs 8-11. This file throttles the decode pool only, for the prefill-vs-decode ablation. gpu_ids are NPU indices; out-of-range ids are rejected at startup. L is a dimensionless workload-history accumulator, NOT temperature. Disabled unless passed via --throttle-config.
